every_recorded_relay_secret_state_is_ans.comment: The relay secret program of ops/ansible/turn.yml at dbfec38e, as recorded by a scratch recorder: each case's file state was built in a private directory, the program ran under the interpreter named here with only its fixed path and its required owner replaced (root is the recording user, other is not), and its exit status, output and the created file's mode, length and alphabet were kept, never its value. A created secret was given to the program a second time. Each case is bound to the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON description.
